record.paper_title: AUTOMORPHISMS AND DYNAMICS: A LIST OF OPEN PROBLEMS
record.context_brief: Positive-entropy automorphisms of projective K3 surfaces with Fatou set
record.original_question: Does there exist a complex projective K3 surface X with an automorphism f: X → X such that f has positive topological entropy and the Fatou set Fat(f) is nonempty, where Fat(f) is the f-invariant open set of points having a neighborhood on which the family of iterates (f^m)_{m∈Z} is normal in the sense of Montel?

evidence.quote: More precisely, define the Fatou set Fat(f) as follows: x ∈ X(C) is in the Fatou set if there is an open neighborhood V of x such that the sequence of iterates (f m)m∈Z forms a normal family on V, in the sense of Montel. This determines an f-invariant open subset Fat(f) ⊂ X(C) on which µf vanishes.
Question 3.4. Does there exist a complex projective K3 surface X with an automorphism f : X → X such that the topological entropy of f is positive and the Fatou set of f is not empty ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective K3 surface, i.e., a simply connected smooth projective surface over $\mathbb{C}$ with trivial canonical bundle. Let $f \colon X \to X$ be an automorphism. Define the Fatou set $\mathrm{Fat}(f) \subset X(\mathbb{C})$ to be the set of points $x \in X(\mathbb{C})$ admitting an open neighborhood $V$ of $x$ (in the complex topology) such that the family of iterates $\{f^m \restriction V : m \in \mathbb{Z}\}$ forms a normal family on $V$ in the sense of Montel. The set $\mathrm{Fat}(f)$ is an $f$-invariant open subset of $X(\mathbb{C})$. Let $h_{\mathrm{top}}(f)$ denote the topological entropy of $f$.

Question: Does there exist a complex projective K3 surface $X$ together with an automorphism $f \colon X \to X$ such that $h_{\mathrm{top}}(f) > 0$ and $\mathrm{Fat}(f) \neq \emptyset$?
artifact.status_search_result: No source found in the web search that resolves whether a complex projective K3 surface admits a positive-entropy automorphism with nonempty Fatou set. Recent literature on K3 surface dynamics (entropy, Salem numbers, automorphism groups) continues to treat this as an open question; no construction or obstruction has been reported.

status_evidence.title: An introduction to K3 surfaces and their dynamics (Filip)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of K3 dynamics discussing entropy, invariant measure, and Fatou/Julia decomposition for automorphisms of K3 surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Standard references on K3 dynamics do not exhibit a positive-entropy projective K3 automorphism with nonempty Fatou set, and the question remains open.

status_evidence.title: K3 surface entropy and automorphism groups
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on the realization of entropies (Salem numbers) of K3 automorphisms; does not address or settle the Fatou-set nonemptiness question.
status_evidence.claim: Recent research on K3 automorphism entropy does not resolve the Fatou set question.
